content.en: The **Human Development Report (HDR)** shifts the focus of development economics from national income accounting to people-centered development. It utilizes the **Human Development Index (HDI)**, a composite statistic of life expectancy, education, and per capita income indicators, to rank countries into four tiers of human development.
